From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai, rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
Date: 2025-06-02T09:25:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Triage: Novamed MAP slippage & options

Hannah / Rishi — I pulled together a compact risk register and two rebaseline options. Attaching the filenames below and a short summary here.

Attachment stubs:
- novamed_risk_register_v1.xlsx (columns: risk, likelihood, impact, mitigation owner, mitigation ETA)
- proposed_map_v2.pdf (timeline swimlane with owner rows and acceptance gates)

Summary (short):
1) Critical path root causes — config validation failures (integration staging mismatch) + one outstanding SOC/logging clarification from their security team. Combined these create a 7-10 business day delay in production dry-run.
2) Option A (2-week buffer): shift Go-Live by 10 business days. Requires Novamed to deliver resolved staging config and sign an acceptance-window amendment. We can commit to an accelerated canary plan (2x validation support) and provide a one-time implementation credit (see credit bands in sheet).
3) Option B (3-week buffer): shift by 15 business days. Lower risk if Novamed cannot expedite config work; includes extended test support and a partial credit escrow until acceptance.

Recommended: present Option A to Procurement with clear owner actions and a proposed DocuSign amendment for the MAP. I flagged the remaining items in the risk register and assigned owners. If Procurement wants more insurance, Option B is our fallback but it requires finance sign-off for escrow.

Next steps I suggest:
- Rishi: finalize the technical remediation steps and ETA for staging config (deliver by 2025-06-02 16:00 PST).
- Hannah: send Option A to Novamed with the proposed DocuSign link and explicit next steps for signature and deliverables.
- I'll loop Finance if Novamed leans toward Option B.

Marissa
Marissa Cole
Deal Lead, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>
To: Elaine Park <elaine.park@novamed.com>, Novamed Procurement <procurement@novamed.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
Date: 2025-06-03T16:05:00-07:00
Subject: Proposed MAP rebaseline (Option A) + immediate containment steps

Elaine / Novamed Procurement —

Thanks for the quick sync this morning. Per our assessment, we recommend Option A: a formal 10-business-day rebaseline to the MAP to preserve overall quality and reduce acceptance risk. Summary below and explicit asks so Procurement has a single doc to review:

What we propose (Option A):
- Go-Live move: from 2025-06-20 to 2025-07-04 (10 business days).
- Actions (owner / ETA):
  - Novamed: deliver corrected staging config and full validation artifacts by 2025-06-09 (owner: Novamed DevOps).
  - Redwood (Rishi): complete accelerated validation and staging sign-off by 2025-06-13.
  - Both Parties: run a joint dry-run week of 2025-06-16 with acceptance criteria agreed in the attached MAP v2.
- Commercial: Redwood proposes a one-time implementation credit (applied at invoice) if the joint dry-run fails for reasons in the attached risk register; details in the credit band sheet.

Why this path? The delay is targeted to remove a single-point failure (staging mismatch) while giving Procurement time to approve the MAP amendment. Option B (15 business days + escrow) remains if Novamed cannot meet the 06/09 deliverable.

Attachments (stubs):
- proposed_map_v2.pdf (updated MAP swimlane + acceptance gates)
- novamed_risk_register_v1.xlsx (detailed risks, owners, mitigations)

Next steps / asks for Procurement:
1) Accept Option A and sign the attached amendment via DocuSign (link: https://docusign.com/Templates/Novamed-MAP-v2).
2) Confirm Novamed DevOps owner and commit to the 2025-06-09 deliverable.
3) If you prefer escrow language instead of a one-time credit, indicate that by 2025-06-04 so we can Triage with Finance.

If you want a brief exec touchpoint to expedite sign-off we can do a 15-minute call tomorrow morning at 8:30 PT.

Thanks,
Hannah Schmitt
Senior Account Manager, Redwood Inference
